items.name: Apache Hive
items.description: SQL data warehouse system for large datasets in distributed storage, and the origin of the Hive Metastore.

items.name: Coalesce
items.description: Visual and code-based platform for building and governing SQL transformations.

items.name: Dataform
items.description: Google Cloud service for developing, testing and scheduling SQL transformations in BigQuery.

items.name: dbt
items.description: Framework for building, testing and documenting SQL transformations with software engineering practices.

items.name: Materialize
items.description: Streaming SQL engine that keeps materialized views up to date as source data changes.

items.name: RisingWave
items.description: Streaming SQL engine that ingests, transforms and serves event streams, with Apache Iceberg support.

items.name: SQLMesh
items.description: Data transformation framework with virtual environments and column-level lineage, compatible with dbt projects.

items.name: Apache Flink
items.description: Distributed engine for stateful stream and batch processing, with Java, Python and SQL APIs.

items.name: Apache Spark
items.description: Unified engine for large-scale data processing, with Python, SQL, Scala, Java and R APIs.
